description: One forearm along a window ledge.
body: Standing, shoulders at an easy diagonal.
hands: Near forearm rests on the ledge, far arm hangs.
legs: Both feet grounded, near knee relaxed.
risks: Keep the resting wrist aligned with the forearm.

description: Seated upright with palms on separate thighs.
body: Upright on a low stool, shoulders level.
hands: One relaxed palm per thigh, fingers together.
legs: Knees apart slightly, both soles flat.
risks: Keep each hand over its own thigh; include shoes only in full-body.

description: A shoulder against the wall, face turned toward the light.
body: Standing at a slight diagonal, upper arm brushes the wall.
hands: Arms hang, wall-side hand can fall outside the crop.
legs: Feet hip-width apart, weight mainly on the inner foot.
support: Both feet with light wall contact.
risks: Keep the wall-side shoulder at its natural height.

description: Lean toward a table on two parallel forearms.
body: Sitting, torso inclined from hips.
hands: Forearms lie parallel on the tabletop, hands visibly apart.
legs: Feet planted below the knees.
risks: Keep the table edge clear of the wrists.

description: Turn back from a balcony rail.
body: Hips face the rail; shoulders and head turn partway back.
hands: Near palm sits flat on the rail; far arm remains low.
legs: Feet slightly staggered, toes generally toward the rail.
risks: Show the supporting elbow and limit spinal rotation.

description: A hand on a chair back, shoulders square.
body: Standing next to the chair with torso upright.
hands: Near palm rests on top without gripping; far arm hangs.
legs: Feet parallel with weight evenly distributed.
support: Both feet and light palm contact.
risks: Avoid making the palm wrap behind the chair edge.

description: Seated sideways with one arm on the chair's backrest.
body: Pelvis stays square to the seat; chest opens toward the viewer.
hands: Near forearm follows top of backrest; free hand rests on near thigh.
legs: Both feet flat, knees point away at a shallow diagonal.
risks: Separate the free elbow from the chair silhouette.

description: Stroll with one foot just landing.
body: Tall torso in a quiet walking stride.
hands: Arms swing only slightly, hands below the hips.
legs: Front heel down, rear toes on floor, stance narrow.
risks: Keep the stride short and preserve the near/far leg order.

description: An open book lies on a stand beneath one relaxed hand.
body: Standing with a small forward nod toward the book.
hands: Near fingertips rest on an open page; other arm hangs.
legs: Feet parallel, knees loose.
support: Both feet and light fingertip contact.
risks: Place fingertips on the page surface with the book edge clear.

description: A quiet straight-on portrait with dropped shoulders.
body: Head centered over upright trunk, chin dipped slightly.
hands: Arms hang outside the portrait crop.
legs: Feet grounded evenly, outside the crop.
risks: Crop clearly above elbows; keep the neck visible.

description: Sit by a window with elbows low and torso in profile.
body: Sitting erect, eyes toward the window.
hands: Window-side forearm rests on a sill; free arm rests on the lap.
legs: Feet flat, knees parallel beneath the table line.
support: Chair, both feet and window-side forearm.
risks: Keep the window sill below the shoulder.

description: Rest the hip lightly on a counter edge.
body: Standing with a small side shift toward the counter.
hands: Near hand flat on counter; far arm hangs beside the hip.
legs: Near leg bears the weight; far foot still on the ground.
support: Near foot with light hip and hand contact.
risks: Keep the pelvis almost level; show daylight between far elbow and torso.

description: Face just past profile with a long, relaxed neck.
body: Shoulders angled away, head turns back to near profile.
hands: Arms lowered outside the portrait crop.
legs: Feet flat; move one foot back by half a step for balance.
risks: Show a clean jawline and leave room above the near shoulder.

description: Sit with one hand on the seat edge.
body: Sitting, upper body tilts a little toward the braced arm.
hands: Near palm flat beside the hip, far hand flat on its thigh.
legs: Knees uncrossed; both feet flat.
support: Seat, near palm and both feet.
risks: Avoid placing fingers on the edge where they merge with the seat.

description: One hand rests lightly against the upper chest.
body: Torso upright with a small turn toward the raised arm.
hands: Near palm rests over the collarbone, fingers aligned; far arm hangs.
legs: Both feet grounded evenly.
support: Both feet; hand touches chest lightly.
risks: Keep fingertips away from the necklace and preserve the wrist contour.

description: Perch at a wide step, one knee higher.
body: Seated with a straight back and hips centered on the step.
hands: Near palm on higher thigh; other palm on the step beside her.
legs: One foot on lower tread; other foot rests one tread higher.
support: Seat tread, two feet and far palm.
risks: The two knees need clear silhouettes; include soles for full-body.

description: Turn slightly to present the edge of a map on a table.
body: Standing, ribcage and hips turn together toward the table.
hands: Near forearm lies next to the map; free hand hangs by the hip.
legs: Feet make a short stagger in the direction of the turn.
risks: Keep the forearm visibly beside the map to avoid accidental gripping.

description: Look down across a resting shoulder from a high angle.
body: Seated, head inclines forward while shoulders stay level.
hands: Hands remain low, flat on either side of the lap.
legs: Feet flat and slightly apart.
risks: Use a mild camera elevation to limit neck foreshortening.

description: Stand beside a doorway with one forearm braced low.
body: Torso opens away from the doorway, head follows.
hands: Near forearm leans against the jamb below shoulder height; other arm down.
legs: Near foot under the hip, far foot a little forward.
risks: Keep elbow and jamb as separate edges.

description: Sit at an angle with both hands on armrests.
body: Pelvis centered, shoulders gently turned toward the light.
hands: Forearms lie on separate armrests, hands relaxed over their tops.
legs: Feet flat and uncrossed.
risks: Keep armrest ends away from the fingertips in projection.

description: Pause at a landing with a hand on the rail.
body: Torso upright, about to turn toward the stairs.
hands: Near hand flat on the broad rail, far arm loose at her side.
legs: Feet on the same landing with one foot angled outward.
support: Both feet and light contact with rail.
risks: Show the rail running under the palm; limit wrist rotation.

description: Hinge from the hips to study something below eye level.
body: Small forward hinge, back long, head aligned with trunk.
hands: Palms rest on the tops of separate thighs.
legs: Heels planted, both knees softly bent.
support: Both feet; light hand pressure against thighs.
risks: Keep the hands high enough to remain inside a mid-thigh crop.

description: Lift the face from the center of a still portrait.
body: Seated, chin gently raised, upper body facing straight ahead.
hands: Forearms rest on thighs outside the bust crop.
legs: Feet flat, out of frame.
risks: Keep the lift slight so the nose and jaw remain distinct.

description: One elbow supported on a table, hand open beside the face.
body: Seated, torso inclines gently toward the planted elbow.
hands: Near elbow on table and forearm upright, open hand beside cheek; far hand stays low.
legs: Both feet flat, knees pointed under the table.
support: Seat, both feet and near elbow.
risks: Leave a visible gap between fingers and face; include the elbow contact.
